title: CORE-7010 · SHARED: FAQ topic pages banner/first-FAQ gap smaller than live
body:
**Linear:** [CORE-7010](https://linear.app/bsq-group/issue/CORE-7010)

## Verified 2026-08-25 — reproduces on all 22 FAQ topic pages

| | live | clone (before) |
|---|---|---|
| banner bottom → first FAQ top | **35px** | **20px** |

Constant at 1800 / 1440 / 1024 / 768 on both sites, so it is a fixed inset, not a responsive drift.

## Where live's 35px comes from

Traced both ancestor chains. Live composes it from two separate boxes:

```
SECTION (banner)   margin-bottom: 15px     <- the clone has 0
SECTION (FAQ)
  DIV (items)      margin-top: 20px        <- the clone already matches (mt-5)
                                    total = 35px
```

The clone's `TitleBanner` image variant renders a bare `<section>` with no spacing at all, so
only the list's own 20px survives.

## Why `pb`, not `mb`

My first attempt added `mb-[15px]` and the gap **did not move** — still 20px, with the class
correctly applied. Adjacent-sibling margin collapsing: the FAQ list's `mt-5` propagates out to
its section, and collapsing against the banner's 15px takes `max(15, 20) = 20`.

Live does not collapse because its `Section` is `display:flex; flex-direction:column`, and flex
containers do not collapse margins with their children.

Rather than convert the FAQ section to flex (a layout change with a much wider blast radius),
the banner contributes its 15px as **padding**, which never collapses. Same rendered result,
no restructuring:

```diff
- imageSection: 'font-legacy-condensed w-full',
+ imageSection: 'font-legacy-condensed w-full',
+ imageSectionContained: 'pb-[15px]',
```

## Scoped to `imageContained` only

`TitleBanner`'s image variants are used by exactly 23 pages: the 22 FAQ topic pages
(`imageContained`) and `/contact-us` (`imageBleed`).

That distinction matters, because live's spacing here is **per-page CMS data**, not a component
constant — live's banner section carries an inline `margin-bottom`, and it is `15px` on the FAQ
pages but `30px` on `/contact-us`. Hard-coding 15px on the shared `imageSection` would therefore
have applied a wrong value to `/contact-us`.

Gating on `variant === 'imageContained'` hits the FAQ pages exactly and leaves `/contact-us`
untouched — verified: its banner section renders without the new class.

## After

| viewport | 1800 | 1440 | 1024 | 768 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| gap | **35** | **35** | **35** | **35** |

Second page cross-checked: `/faqs/vat` — live 35, after 35.

![before/after](https://60cfqkpecvp2z01z.public.blob.vercel-storage.com/pr-screenshots/core-7010/gap-before-after.png)

**BEFORE** = `rapid-formations-clone.vercel.app` (`main`) · **AFTER** = local production build of this branch.

> The Vercel preview could not be used: it is SSO-walled and returns `<title>Login – Vercel</title>` with **HTTP 200**, so an automated screenshot of it captures a login page rather than the app.

## Follow-up worth filing separately

`/contact-us` has the same class of defect in the other direction: live gives its banner a 30px
bottom margin, the clone gives it 0. Out of scope for this ticket, and it needs the `imageBleed`
path, so I have not touched it.

## Checks

- `bun run ts` clean · `bun run build` green
- gap measured on two FAQ topic pages across four viewports
- `/contact-us` confirmed unchanged
acceptanceCriteria: Banner bottom to first FAQ top measures 35px on FAQ topic pages, matching live.
Holds at 1800 / 1440 / 1024 / 768 on at least two FAQ topic pages.
/contact-us (imageBleed variant) is unchanged — live uses 30px there, not 15px.
No margin-collapsing regression: the value must actually render, not just appear in the class list.
